concerns.text: T007 (Producer of Taxonomy/Calendar) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly requires T008 (Directory Setup). T008 is also marked [P]. This creates a hidden ordering dependency within a 'parallel' block. T007 cannot run in parallel with T008; it must wait for T008 to complete. The [P] tag on T007 is incorrect.

T015 (Mapping) is marked [P] but requires T039 (External Metrics Fetch). T039 is also marked [P]. T015 reads the artifact produced by T039 (`external_metrics.json`). These cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag on T015 is incorrect.

T016 (Bootstrapping) is marked [P] but requires T014 (Trends). T014 produces `trend_intermediate.json` which T016 likely needs for context or input data. Even if T016 only needs the raw data, the task description implies a sequential flow (T014 -> T016). Marking T016 as [P] suggests it can run concurrently with T014, which violates the producer-consumer flow.
T018 (Aggregation) is marked [P] but requires T016 and T040. T018 is the consumer of artifacts from T016 and T040. It cannot run in parallel with them. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T030 (Cluster Alignment) is marked [P] but requires T007 (Taxonomy Generation) and T029 (Clustering). T007 is a foundational producer. T030 cannot run in parallel with T007 or T029. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T032 (Cluster Results) is marked [P] but requires T030. T032 consumes the output of T030. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.
